status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Neumorphism
summary: Softly raised surfaces with tactile, understated depth.
use_when: Use for small tools, settings panels, and focused utility cards.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: System sans-serif with clear medium-weight labels.
layout: Spacious inset and raised groups with explicit labels.
surfaces: Paired soft light/dark shadows and clear control outlines.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Neumorphism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with clear medium-weight labels. Spacious inset and raised groups with explicit labels. Paired soft light/dark shadows and clear control outlines. Palette: background #e8edf1, surface #e8edf1, text #263544, muted #526171, accent #275c78, border #aab7c3. Essential traits: Raised and inset relief; Monochrome surface family; Explicit boundaries on controls. Avoid: Shadow-only affordances; Low-contrast text; Unlabeled states. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
